blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — safe alendronate administration
stem: A client is prescribed oral alendronate for osteoporosis. Which statement by the client indicates correct understanding of administration?

options.A: I will take it when I get up with 6 to 8 ounces of plain water, before food or other medicines, and remain upright for at least 30 minutes and until after my first food.
options.B: I will take it at bedtime with a small amount of water and remain lying down so the tablet stays in contact with the esophagus long enough to improve absorption.
options.C: I will take it with breakfast and milk because food and calcium increase alendronate absorption while reducing the chance of upper gastrointestinal irritation.
options.D: I will take it with plain water after breakfast, then lie down when comfortable because the upright-position requirement ends once the tablet has been swallowed.

rationale: Current alendronate labeling directs patients to take the tablet upon arising with 6 to 8 ounces of plain water at least 30 minutes before the first food, beverage, or medication of the day and not to lie down for at least 30 minutes and until after the first food. These steps preserve absorption and reduce esophageal irritation. Therefore A is correct.
educational_objective: Administer oral alendronate on arising with plain water before food/other medications and remain upright at least 30 minutes and until after the first food.
source_document_title: ALENDRONATE SODIUM tablets — Full Prescribing Information
source_locator: §2.6 Important Administration Instructions: 6-8 oz plain water upon arising, ≥30 minutes before first food/beverage/medication, no lying down for ≥30 minutes and until after first food; rationale includes absorption and esophageal irritation.
source_claim_supported: Correct alendronate administration requires plain water, fasting separation, and upright positioning to preserve absorption and reduce esophageal injury.
blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: prepare/administer medications safely and educate clients about medication administration.
candidate_reasons_resolved: Rewrote all four choices as complete administration sequences of comparable length.
audit_note: Independent adversarial review confirms A uniquely matches the May 2026 alendronate label; options are tightly length-balanced.
